calendarFaqs.q: When does Columbus City Schools start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: On the traditional calendar, grades 1–12 start Thursday, August 20, 2026, kindergarten starts Tuesday, August 25, and Pre-K starts Tuesday, September 8. Woodcrest grades 1–5 start July 23.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCS Wellness Week in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: All schools are closed Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. November 25 is the compensatory day for parent conferences within that closure.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCS Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027. Woodcrest then has a separate January 4-8 intersession.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Traditional schools are closed March 26 through April 2, 2027. Woodcrest has intersession March 22-25 and April 5-9 around the same district closure.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day for CCS students in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The traditional-calendar last day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. Woodcrest students finish Wednesday, June 2.

calendarFaqs.q: Which Quarter 2 end date is correct for CCS 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The linked official PDF marks Thursday, January 14, 2027. The calendar hub summary currently says January 12, so this page follows the PDF and flags the discrepancy.
